_comment: Boot gate for GPT-2 training hosts (4090/5090 class). Unlike SmallCore this workload IS FLOP-bound, so bf16 throughput gets a real floor again (a healthy 4090 measures ~150+, a 5090 ~236; 80 rejects broken or misdescribed cards without rejecting an A100). drive_pull_mbps guards the 7.5 GB token-cache pull from the Drive bank (a 24 Mbps host once cost a boot 10 extra minutes; 100 Mbps caps the pull at ~10 min — measured 2026-07-28: two healthy PRO 6000 hosts pulled at 128-132, so 150 was rejecting good machines). disk floor: the cache + checkpoints are written to /workspace, and a 10 MB/s disk burned a run on 2026-07-26. Re-derive with `launch.py scan` when changing GPU class.
